## 1. Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
```

## 2. Define Paths

```{r paths}
# Paths are relative to the project root (see README for the data layout)
data_dir          <- here::here("data", "tcga_ucec")              # raw GDC downloads
sample_sheet_path <- here::here("data", "gdc_sample_sheet.tsv")   # GDC sample sheet
results_dir       <- here::here("results")                         # intermediate .RData
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 3. Read and Explore the GDC Sample Sheet


```{r read-sample-sheet}
sample_sheet <- read_tsv(sample_sheet_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# See all column names
cat("Column names in sample sheet:\n")
print(colnames(sample_sheet))

cat("\nDimensions:", nrow(sample_sheet), "rows x", ncol(sample_sheet), "columns\n")
```

```{r explore-sample-sheet}
# Preview the full data
head(sample_sheet)

print(table(sample_sheet$`Data Type`))
print(table(sample_sheet$`Tissue Type`))
```

## 4. Identify RNA-Seq and miRNA-Seq Files on Disk

```{r list-files}
rna_files <- list.files(data_dir,
                        pattern = "rna_seq\\.augmented_star_gene_counts\\.tsv$",
                        recursive = TRUE,
                        full.names = TRUE)

mirna_files <- list.files(data_dir,
                          pattern = "mirbase21\\.mirnas\\.quantification\\.txt$",
                          recursive = TRUE,
                          full.names = TRUE)

cat("RNA-Seq files found on disk:", length(rna_files), "\n")
cat("miRNA-Seq files found on disk:", length(mirna_files), "\n")
```

## 5. Inspect One RNA-Seq File

```{r inspect-rna}
test_rna <- read_tsv(rna_files[1], comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(test_rna), "rows x", ncol(test_rna), "columns\n\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(colnames(test_rna))
head(test_rna, 10)
```

The first 4 rows are summary statistics (`N_unmapped`, `N_multimapping`, `N_noFeature`, `N_ambiguous`) — these need to be removed. The `gene_type` column contains GENCODE biotype annotations (e.g., `protein_coding`, `lncRNA`) that we'll use to separate mRNAs from lncRNAs.

## 6. Inspect One miRNA-Seq File

```{r inspect-mirna}
test_mirna <- read_tsv(mirna_files[1], show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(test_mirna), "rows x", ncol(test_mirna), "columns\n\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(colnames(test_mirna))
head(test_mirna, 10)
```

## 7. Read All RNA-Seq Count Files

```{r read-rnaseq-function}
read_rnaseq <- function(filepath) {
  df <- read_tsv(filepath, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Remove the first 4 summary rows
  df <- df[-(1:4), ]
  
  # Extract the UUID folder name (this matches "File ID" in the sample sheet)
  uuid <- basename(dirname(filepath))
  
  # Keep gene annotation + unstranded counts
  df <- df %>%
    select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type, unstranded) %>%
    rename(!!uuid := unstranded)
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r read-all-rnaseq, cache=TRUE}
message("Reading ", length(rna_files), " RNA-Seq files")

# Read the first file to get gene annotations
rna_first <- read_rnaseq(rna_files[1])
gene_info <- rna_first %>% select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type)

# Read all files, keeping only gene_id + counts
rna_counts_list <- lapply(rna_files, function(f) {
  df <- read_rnaseq(f)
  df %>% select(-gene_name, -gene_type)  # just gene_id + count column
})

# Merge all into one data frame by gene_id
rna_merged <- rna_counts_list %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "gene_id")

# Re-attach gene annotations
rna_merged <- left_join(gene_info, rna_merged, by = "gene_id")

cat("RNA-Seq merged matrix:", nrow(rna_merged), "genes x",
    ncol(rna_merged) - 3, "samples\n")
```

## 8. Read All miRNA-Seq Count Files

```{r read-mirna-function}
read_mirna <- function(filepath) {
  df <- read_tsv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)
  uuid <- basename(dirname(filepath))
  df <- df %>%
    select(miRNA_ID, read_count) %>%
    rename(!!uuid := read_count)
  return(df)
}
```

```{r read-all-mirna, cache=TRUE}
message("Reading ", length(mirna_files), " miRNA-Seq files...")

mirna_counts_list <- lapply(mirna_files, read_mirna)

mirna_merged <- mirna_counts_list %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "miRNA_ID")

cat("miRNA-Seq merged matrix:", nrow(mirna_merged), "miRNAs x",
    ncol(mirna_merged) - 1, "samples\n")
```

## 9. Build UUID-to-Barcode Mapping from Sample Sheet

```{r uuid-mapping}
# Get the UUIDs from our count matrices
rna_uuids   <- colnames(rna_merged)[-(1:3)]   # exclude gene_id, gene_name, gene_type
mirna_uuids <- colnames(mirna_merged)[-1]      # exclude miRNA_ID

# Split the sample sheet by data type
rna_sample_info <- sample_sheet %>%
  filter(`File ID` %in% rna_uuids)

mirna_sample_info <- sample_sheet %>%
  filter(`File ID` %in% mirna_uuids)

cat("RNA-Seq files matched to sample sheet:", nrow(rna_sample_info), "/", length(rna_uuids), "\n")
cat("miRNA-Seq files matched to sample sheet:", nrow(mirna_sample_info), "/", length(mirna_uuids), "\n")

cat("\n--- RNA-Seq Tissue Types ---\n")
print(table(rna_sample_info$`Tissue Type`))

cat("\n--- miRNA-Seq Tissue Types ---\n")
print(table(mirna_sample_info$`Tissue Type`))
```

## 10. Match Patients with Both RNA-Seq and miRNA-Seq

For the sensitivity correlation analysis, each patient needs **both** RNA-Seq and miRNA-Seq data from the same tissue type. We match using `Case ID` + `Tissue Type`

```{r match-patients}
# Create match keys from Case ID + Tissue Type
rna_sample_info <- rna_sample_info %>%
  mutate(match_key = paste(`Case ID`, `Tissue Type`, sep = "_"))

mirna_sample_info <- mirna_sample_info %>%
  mutate(match_key = paste(`Case ID`, `Tissue Type`, sep = "_"))

# Find patients with both data types
matched <- inner_join(
  rna_sample_info %>% select(`File ID`, `Case ID`, `Tissue Type`, match_key),
  mirna_sample_info %>% select(`File ID`, `Case ID`, `Tissue Type`, match_key),
  by = "match_key",
  suffix = c("_rna", "_mirna")
)

cat("Total matched patient-samples:", nrow(matched), "\n")

# Check for duplicates (multiple aliquots per patient)
dup_check <- matched %>% count(match_key, sort = TRUE)
cat("Patients with >1 match:", sum(dup_check$n > 1), "\n")

# If duplicates exist, keep only one per patient
if (any(dup_check$n > 1)) {
  matched <- matched %>%
    distinct(match_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
  cat("After deduplication:", nrow(matched), "matched samples\n")
}

# Tissue type is already right there — just use it
matched <- matched %>%
  mutate(tissue = `Tissue Type_rna`)

cat("\n--- Matched samples by tissue type ---\n")
print(table(matched$tissue))
```

## 11. Separate mRNAs and lncRNAs by Gene Biotype

Using the GENCODE `gene_type` annotations from the STAR output, we split genes into protein-coding (mRNA) and lncRNA categories.

```{r separate-biotypes}
cat("Top 15 gene biotypes in the data:\n")
gene_info %>% count(gene_type, sort = TRUE) %>% head(15) %>% print()

mrna_genes   <- gene_info %>% filter(gene_type == "protein_coding")
lncrna_genes <- gene_info %>% filter(gene_type == "lncRNA")

cat("\nProtein-coding (mRNA) genes:", nrow(mrna_genes), "\n")
cat("lncRNA genes:", nrow(lncrna_genes), "\n")
```

## 12 + 13. Build Clean Numeric Count Matrices, Rename, and Align

We subset to matched samples only, split by RNA biotype, convert to numeric, rename UUIDs to match keys, and ensure all three matrices are aligned by patient .

```{r build-rename-align}
# Get matched File IDs
matched_rna_uuids   <- matched$`File ID_rna`
matched_mirna_uuids <- matched$`File ID_mirna`

# Barcode mapping vectors (UUID -> match_key)
rna_uuid_to_key   <- setNames(matched$match_key, matched$`File ID_rna`)
mirna_uuid_to_key <- setNames(matched$match_key, matched$`File ID_mirna`)

# --- RNA-Seq: subset to matched samples only ---
rna_sub <- rna_merged %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type, all_of(matched_rna_uuids))

# mRNA matrix
mrna_count_matrix <- rna_sub %>%
  filter(gene_type == "protein_coding") %>%
  select(-gene_name, -gene_type) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")
mrna_count_matrix[] <- lapply(mrna_count_matrix, as.numeric)

# lncRNA matrix
lncrna_count_matrix <- rna_sub %>%
  filter(gene_type == "lncRNA") %>%
  select(-gene_name, -gene_type) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")
lncrna_count_matrix[] <- lapply(lncrna_count_matrix, as.numeric)

# miRNA matrix
mirna_count_matrix <- mirna_merged %>%
  select(miRNA_ID, all_of(matched_mirna_uuids)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("miRNA_ID")
mirna_count_matrix[] <- lapply(mirna_count_matrix, as.numeric)

# Verify mrna and lncrna have identical columns BEFORE renaming
cat("mrna cols == lncrna cols (before rename)?",
    identical(colnames(mrna_count_matrix), colnames(lncrna_count_matrix)), "\n")

# Rename UUID columns to match keys
colnames(mrna_count_matrix)   <- rna_uuid_to_key[colnames(mrna_count_matrix)]
colnames(lncrna_count_matrix) <- rna_uuid_to_key[colnames(lncrna_count_matrix)]
colnames(mirna_count_matrix)  <- mirna_uuid_to_key[colnames(mirna_count_matrix)]

# Reorder all three to the same match key order
shared_keys <- intersect(colnames(mrna_count_matrix), colnames(mirna_count_matrix))
cat("Shared sample keys across RNA and miRNA:", length(shared_keys), "\n")

mrna_count_matrix   <- mrna_count_matrix[, shared_keys]
lncrna_count_matrix <- lncrna_count_matrix[, shared_keys]
mirna_count_matrix  <- mirna_count_matrix[, shared_keys]

# Final verification
stopifnot(identical(colnames(mrna_count_matrix), colnames(lncrna_count_matrix)))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(mrna_count_matrix), colnames(mirna_count_matrix)))

cat("All three matrices aligned. Samples:", ncol(mrna_count_matrix), "\n")
cat("First 5 sample keys:", head(colnames(mrna_count_matrix), 5), "\n")

cat("\nmRNA count matrix:", nrow(mrna_count_matrix), "genes x", ncol(mrna_count_matrix), "samples\n")
cat("lncRNA count matrix:", nrow(lncrna_count_matrix), "genes x", ncol(lncrna_count_matrix), "samples\n")
cat("miRNA count matrix:", nrow(mirna_count_matrix), "miRNAs x", ncol(mirna_count_matrix), "samples\n")
```

## 14. Create Tissue Label Vector

```{r tissue-labels}
tissue_labels <- setNames(matched$tissue, matched$match_key)
tissue_vec <- tissue_labels[colnames(mrna_count_matrix)]

cat("Tumor samples:", sum(tissue_vec == "Tumor"), "\n")
cat("Normal samples:", sum(tissue_vec == "Normal"), "\n")
```

## 15. Filter Low-Expression Genes

Retain genes expressed (≥ minimum count) in at least 10% of samples

```{r filter-low-expression}
filter_low_expr <- function(count_df, min_count = 10, min_fraction = 0.10) {
  keep <- rowSums(count_df >= min_count) >= (ncol(count_df) * min_fraction)
  count_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

mrna_filtered   <- filter_low_expr(mrna_count_matrix, min_count = 10)
lncrna_filtered <- filter_low_expr(lncrna_count_matrix, min_count = 10)
mirna_filtered  <- filter_low_expr(mirna_count_matrix, min_count = 5)

cat("After filtering (expressed in ≥10% of samples):\n")
cat("  mRNAs:", nrow(mrna_filtered), " (from", nrow(mrna_count_matrix), ")\n")
cat("  lncRNAs:", nrow(lncrna_filtered), " (from", nrow(lncrna_count_matrix), ")\n")
cat("  miRNAs:", nrow(mirna_filtered), " (from", nrow(mirna_count_matrix), ")\n")
```

```{r save}
save(

  mrna_count_matrix, lncrna_count_matrix, mirna_count_matrix,
  gene_info, mrna_genes, lncrna_genes,
  matched, tissue_vec,
  sample_sheet,
  file = file.path(results_dir, "processed_data.RData")
)

cat("Saved to:", file.path(results_dir, "processed_data.RData"), "\n")
```
